name: Fusb302B → On Connect
description:
An automation to perform when a source is attached. See [`on_connect` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fusb302b/#on_connect-trigger).

This automation is triggered when a source is attached to the USB-C port, before power negotiation starts. It is also triggered when a source is detected again after communication with the FUSB302B is restored.
